svg.title: Mind Map Studio: present mode
svg.desc: A looping animation in three scenes. 1: F5 turns the map into a dark full-screen presentation. Step 1 of 8 shows the central topic Launch plan, step 2 the branch Pricing, step 3 the branch Hiring (main branches go clockwise), and step 4 Pricing’s first child Tiers, with earlier steps dimmed. 2: N shows the notes of Tiers as a card, B blanks the screen and B brings it back; after Esc, Shift+F5 starts presenting at the selected node Trials, step 6 of 8. 3: an exported HTML page opened from a file in a browser presents the same way when F5 is pressed.

g.text: Press F5 to present the map, one node at a time.
The centre, then each branch clockwise, then into them. Earlier steps dim.
N shows the notes of this step; B blanks the screen, B brings it back.
Shift+F5 starts presenting at the selected node.
Shift+F5 starts presenting at the selected node.
An exported HTML file presents the same way: no app, no network.
